outputs.explanation: Panel A is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.
Panel B shows phase-contrast micrographs, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.

The bottom bar chart (mean ± SEM, n=3) overlays individual data points as circles, squares, and triangles for each replicate on top of the bars; the top flow cytometry dot plots are themselves individual-cell scatter data.
The bottom bar chart (mean ± SD, n=3) shows individual replicate data points overlaid on each bar; the top flow cytometry plots are individual-cell scatter data.
Panel E is a heatmap of Z-scores; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
